summary: Comprehensive testing of CollabSpace MVP. Backend: 15/15 tests pass (health, auth register/login/me/invalid, categories/regions, influencer search filters, requests + self-400, incoming/outgoing boxes, PATCH accept RBAC, conversations + messages + REST send, WebSocket chat broadcast, MOCK Razorpay create-order/verify with tier-based fee, contact 402 -> unlock, campaign requires unlock (400 pre / 200 post), campaign lifecycle + reviews aggregation, admin analytics/users/verify with non-admin 403). Frontend end-to-end: seeded login (brand/creator/admin), Discover screen with sticky horizontal chip row + search + category filter, creator detail with hero/metrics/pricing/sticky CTA, Send Request modal -> chat navigation with negotiation cards, WebSocket chat send works, MOCK payment sheet unlocks contact card + reveals Start Campaign CTA, Profile + Edit Profile with all creator fields, Admin panel shows analytics tiles (Users=8/Creators=4/Brands=3/Requests=4/Deals=2/Revenue=₹198), filter chips, verify/delete rows. Deprecated packages detected: none (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch). React Native deprecation warnings detected: props.pointerEvents on View (creator/[id].tsx) and shadow* style props somewhere in styles — non-blocking but should be migrated.

react_native_issues.issue: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents instead. Reference: /app/frontend/app/creator/[id].tsx:~stickyBar line uses pointerEvents="box-none" as a prop
React Native Web warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' equivalents. Reference: appears in multiple styled cards (creator/discover/admin)

action_items: Optional cleanup: replace pointerEvents="box-none" prop with style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }} in /app/frontend/app/creator/[id].tsx
Optional cleanup: migrate legacy shadow* StyleSheet props (shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowRadius/shadowOpacity) to boxShadow for React Native Web to silence deprecation warnings
Consider seed idempotency for stray users created during dev/testing (e.g., 'aaditya raj' + previous TEST_ users) — not blocking
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1030 lines and cleanly organised with sections — acceptable but could split auth/chat/payments if it grows further
MOCK Razorpay path correctly returns amount_inr per tier and accepts any signature — behaviour documented for production replacement
get_current_user is timezone-safe and TTL index expires_at is set on user_sessions — good
MongoDB _id stripped everywhere via strip_mongo/find projection — good
WebSocket auth via query token is correct pattern for React Native (no header support); participant guard enforced
CORS is fully open; acceptable for mobile app + web preview
seed_data_creation: No new seed data added. Tests create TEST_-prefixed users/requests/campaigns via APIs and cleanup via admin DELETE at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_collabspace.py covers auth, discovery, requests, conversations, WebSocket, MOCK payments + unlock, campaign + review aggregation, and admin RBAC. Runs in ~5s. Uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. For UI, all screens expose data-testid attributes (see login-*, discover-*, chip-*, creator-card-*, creator-detail, send-request-*, chat-*, unlock-contact-button, payment-sheet, confirm-payment-button, create-campaign-button, profile-*, edit-profile-*, admin-*, verify-*, delete-*). Payment gateway is MOCKED — Razorpay create-order returns order_MOCK<hex> and verify accepts any signature. Chat WebSocket at /api/ws/chat/{conv_id}?token=<session_token> works via wss:// in the preview.
rca_of_issue: No unresolved issues. During first pytest run, my test used a .test TLD which pydantic EmailStr rejected — corrected to @example.com and all tests now pass.
